_what_this_is: Alternative mandates for the same grant. Each scenario is a deployer's sentence and the primitives it wants and refuses; everything else is unstated. The grant never changes; the delta is recomputed per scenario. Written on this site as starting points to be argued with.

scenarios.label: Fix a bug and open a PR
scenarios.description: Change the repository it was pointed at, run the tests, push a branch and open a pull request.

scenarios.label: Review a pull request, read-only
scenarios.description: Read the change and the code around it, run what it needs to, and comment. Change nothing.

scenarios.label: Run the test suite and report
scenarios.description: Run the tests and tell me what failed.

scenarios.label: Ship a release: tag, sign, push
scenarios.description: Cut the release, sign the tag with the key it holds and push it to the code host.

scenarios.label: Refactor across many repositories
scenarios.description: The same change in every repository it can reach on the code host.

scenarios.label: Nightly maintenance, on a schedule
scenarios.description: A session that runs every night without me: update dependencies, run the tests, push if green.
